reason: It looks nice and the button and offline alarm are sensible, but I would still keep my phone next to me, so I would be paying 120 euros for a second alarm clock. I would not pre-order something that does not exist yet from a company I have never heard of.
objection: I need my phone near me anyway, for emergencies or the kids. Relying on a favourites setting to ring through from another room feels risky, and I would be paying 120 euros for a pre-order of a device nobody has reviewed yet.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it finished and reviewed by real owners, and a way to test that urgent calls reliably wake me with the phone in another room. A price nearer 80 would help.
